tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang sngags rnying ma spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / phur pod yang gsang spu gri'i byung tshul gyi yi ge bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra kī la ya/ 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma'i rnam gzhag cung zad zhig brjod na/ spyir gsang sngags rnying ma 'di la bka' gter gnyis las/ bka' ma'i dbang du byas na/ sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur sogs dang tshul 'dra ba'i grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon so so nas bzung / da lta'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa byon pa'i chos bskor du ma zhig yod la/ gter ma la bsgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad du yod pa las/ de yang bskyed pa mahā yo ga ste bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i gter kha gong mar grags pa/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi rnam 'phrul mnga' bdag myang ral gyi gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i skor dang / lung a nu yo ga ste rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i gter kha 'og mar grags pa/ myang ral gyi sprul pa gu ru chos dbang gis lho gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi skor dang / bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug ston pa rig 'dzin rgod ldeb kyi byang gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad drag po rang byung rang shar gyi skor dang / gzhan yang sprul sku bde chen gling pas gter nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' brgyad khro 'bar ma dang / padma gling pas gter nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs kyi me long la sogs pa bka' brgyad kyi skor mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa las/ de lta bu'i bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor rnam gzhag 'di ltar 'byung ste/ dbus su bdud rtsi yon tan che mchog rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor/ shar du dpal chen badzra he ru ka yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ lhor 'jam dpal sku'i dkyil 'khor/ nub tu padma gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ byang du phur pa 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor/

shar lhor mngon rdzogs rgyal po bla med he ru ka ma mo rbod gtong gi dkyil 'khor/ lho nub tu bla ma rig 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor/ nub byang du phyag rdor dregs pa kun 'dul 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi dkyil 'khor/ byang shar du drag po stobs ldan nag po dmod pa drag sngags kyi dkyil 'khor te dkyil 'khor dgu po 'di gzhal yas khang gcig gi nang du chug pa zhig 'byung ba yin la/ 'di rnams la lha grangs mang nyung mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung yang / phyi'i khyams kyi bka' srung sogs kun dril bas lha grangs bdun brgya dang nyer lngar grangs nges pa yin la/ 'di kun gyi sgrub thabs dkyil chog dbang bskur sogs dpe steng nas nyams su len pa rnying ma ba rang gi lugs kyi phyag len gyi mchog yin te/ lugs 'di la mkhas pa'i snga rabs kyi bla ma rnams kyi gsungs las/ rab shog ser gyi steng nas nyams su len/ 'bring shog ser zhal bshus ma 'chugs pa'i dpe thog nas nyams su len/ tha ma lce thog nas nyams su len rung ba tsam yin zhes 'byung ba yin no/ de lta bu'i bka' brgyad rtsa ba las 'phros pa'i bka' brgyad bye brag ma'i nang tshan 'phrin las phur pa'i chos skor la/ lho gter nas gu ru chos dbang gi spyan drangs pa'i phur pa yang gsang spu gri'i skor dang / ratna gling pas gter nas spyan drangs pa'i phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi skor/ byang gter nas rig 'dzin rgod ldem pas spyan drangs pa'i phur pa'i skor la/ bskyed pa mahā yo ga dang sgo 'bril ba phur pa lha khra'am/ che mchog gi skor/ lung a nu yo ga gzhir bzhag pa'i phur pa lha nag gam drag sngags kyi skor/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga dang sgo 'brel ba'i phur pa lha 'dus sam dril sgrub kyi skor rnams su yod cing / de lta bu'i bka' brgyad rtsa ba dang bye brag gi lung man ngag rnams zhu ba'i sngon du/ rab chos skor de dang 'brel ba'i gter kha so so'i de dang de'i dbang thob pa zhig dgos pa yin la/

de min na'ang sa lugs kyi yang phur sogs snga 'gyur gyi bka' ma lhad med gang rung zhig gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa zhig dgos pa yin cing / tha na'ang gsang sngags gsar rnying gang rung gi bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung gcig tu dbang bskur ba thob pa gcig nges par dgos pa yin zhes rnying ma ba la mkhas pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams gsungs pa yin la/ 'dir skabs su babs pa phur pa yang gsang bla med kyi bskor rnams byung ba'i tshul ni/ 'dir smras pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug padma 'byung gnas kyis/ /yang gsang spu gri'i chos bskor zab mo 'di/ /lho phyogs gnam skas brag la gter du sbas/ /dus phyis gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis/ /gter nas spyan drangs 'phrin las dar rgyas spel/ /de nas rim bzhin brgyud de rig sngags 'chang / tshe'i rig 'dzin dbang po ngag dbang lhas/ /rjes bzung rig pa 'dzin pa kun tu bzang / /snga 'gyur chos kyi nyi ma snyan grags kyi/ /rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal 'byor bzang po can/ /gang de'i bar du legs par byon pa yi/ /yang gsang spu gri'i chos skor 'di nyid la/ /phur pa rtsa ba'i dum bu gtsor gyur pa'i/ /zab las ches zab chos sna'i rkang grangs ni/ /lnga phrag bzhi dang gsum gyi lhag pa bzhugs/ /de lta'i chos tshul rgya mtsho'i zab gnad kyi/ /bdud rtsi nying khu tshim par rol ba las/ /gzung 'dzin gdod nas grol ba rang gi gshis/ /rang tshang rig pa sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams ma yin nam/ /zhes pa 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bgyis pa'i yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba gso ba rig pa dang / yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa bas pa don grub kyis bgyis pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ phur pod yang gsang spu gri'i chos skor rnams zhu ba la lugs de nyid rang gi gter ma'i dbang ma thob kyang /

phur pa sa lugs kyi smin byed kyi dbang thob pas mchog tu legs par 'gyur ba yin no/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi don 'grel legs par bshad pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
